name: odbvue
title: OdbVue
description: The meta framework for Oracle Database and Vue.js
author: Jānis Erlihs

scripts.build:odb: pnpm --filter @odbvue/odb run check && pnpm --filter @odbvue/odb run build && pnpm --filter @odbvue/db run check && pnpm --filter @odbvue/db run build
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @odbvue/web run check && pnpm --filter @odbvue/web run build && pnpm --filter apps run check && pnpm --filter apps run build
